title: Aurora, Texas airship crash and alien buried beside Chris's family cemetery

tellings.quote: In fact, the first report that I've heard of in America was Aurora, Texas. It was a sky ship that crashed into the wind tower. Right. >> 1897. >> And they buried an alien there. You know where they buried him? >> Where? >> In my family. Right beside my family cemetery.

plain: In 1897, a "sky ship" is said to have crashed into a wind tower in Aurora, Texas, and the alien on board was buried in the town. Chris Bledsoe, a man who says UFOs are drawn to him, tells Michels it was the first such report he knows of in America, and adds that the alien was buried "right beside my family cemetery."
